Victory Independent Living

Repo (in development)

Co-founder & developer

Housing intake and partner recruitment web app for a Valdosta independent-living program.

Tenant applications and partner sign-ups with UTM tracking, plus contact and resources pages, as a static build ready for Hostinger. Vite, React, and TypeScript, with optional Gemini-powered local insights. Form endpoints are still being connected.
